mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, which directly supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0%, it signals an overheating labor market that accelerates consumer spending and corporate profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 5.0%, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in residential fixed investment (RSAFS) signals coordinated monetary easing and fiscal stimulus, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint FEDFUNDS decline and RSAFS increase fails to produce positive returns in more than 55% of 60-day horizons.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an impending economic slowdown that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%), SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases when UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand for housing, which correlates with broader economic expansion and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decline fails to produce positive returns in more than 55% of 60-day horizons.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO < 95.0, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.
